I stayed here for about 15–16 days; it was my first time in India overall, and I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. I was never a big fan of Indian cuisine before, but this trip completely changed my mind.

Breakfast was included, and since I usually don’t eat spicy food in the morning, I only had fruits and boiled eggs on my first day. The manager noticed and kindly asked if I had any preferences; I just mentioned I’d love some cheese and fresh vegetables, and from then on, it was ready on the table for me every morning. I found that so thoughtful and sweet. (Yes yes I’m picky sometimes 🤪).

The room was cleaned, refreshed, and tidy every single day. I also used the laundry service a few times; it was super convenient.

Attaching a couple of pictures of my dinners from those days; every meal looked as good as it tasted. Overall, a truly great experience with wonderful hospitality, highly recommend!
If I’m coming back again to India , def would choose the same hotel chain again.  🫶🏼🙂‍↔️

negative_snippets:
Extremely Disappointing Stay — Poor Maintenance and Rude Staff

We had a thoroughly unpleasant experience during our two-day stay at this hotel. We had booked four rooms, and shockingly, the flush was not working in any of them. Even the common toilet had the same issue — completely unacceptable for any hotel, let alone one charging decent rates.
The cleanliness was pathetic — the bedsheets and linens were soiled, and the rooms smelled unpleasant. It was evident that proper cleaning and maintenance are not a priority here.
The restaurant staff were extremely rude and unhelpful. Something as basic as requesting a spoon or water was met with arrogance — they told us to “go collect it from the tray” instead of serving it at the table. They don’t even bother to serve drinking water properly, which shows a complete lack of hospitality.
To make matters worse, they had promised a welcome drink at check-in, which was never provided — another example of how little they care about guests or their own commitments.
Overall, this place lacks basic hygiene, maintenance, and customer service standards. I would strongly advise against staying here unless major improvements are made in staff behavior, cleanliness, and facility upkeep. Definitely not worth the money or the inconvenience
